indication: esophageal - gastric varices bleeding caused by cirrhosis emergency treatment, combination the use of special treatment (such as endoscopic sclerotherapy)
alleviate signs and symptoms associated with gastrointestinal endocrine tumors
recommended_usage: continually intravenous infusion at 0.025mg/hour, the maximal treatment day is 5 days
0.1 mg subcutaneous injection, three times a day, continuous treatment for 7 days, the first injection should be at least 1 hour before surgery
